params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an ability, {{cis|Lucian}} next {{tip|basic attack}} within a few seconds fires a second attack that deals {{as|'''reduced''' physical damage}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Vigilance:}} Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}}, or when a nearby enemy is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within a few seconds are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. The shots can stack up to a cap.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Lucian's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|3.5}} seconds fires an additional shot {{tip|on-attack}} after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 60|1;7;13}} AD {{as|physical damage}}}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}. He will shoot the same target, else another target within 50 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}} automatically.
params.description2: The second shot {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Vigilance:}} Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}} by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal {{as|5|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.
params.notes:
* ''Lightslinger'' is triggered and consumed by the first attack, even if no target can be found upon firing the second attack.
* The second attack, if the initial target was killed, will prioritize enemy champions regardless of having {{tip|sight}} of them or not and enemy {{tip|minion|minions}} with {{sti|health|{{as|low health}}}}.
* '''Lucian''' can perform actions freely while firing ''Lightslinger's'' second attack.
** The second attack has special movement animations depending on the direction '''Lucian''' is moving while firing.
* The second attack counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* The second attack separately rolls a {{tip|critical strike}}.
* The second attack does not trigger {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}}.{{bug|2}}
* The empowered shots will apply against structures.

blurb.plain: Innate: After casting an ability, Lucian next basic attack within a few seconds fires a second attack that deals reduced physical damage.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Vigilance: Whenever Lucian is healed or shielded, or when a nearby enemy is immobilized, his next two shots within a few seconds are empowered to deal bonus magic damage. The shots can stack up to a cap.

description.plain: Innate: After casting an ability, Lucian's next basic attack within 3.5 seconds fires an additional shot on-attack after 0.25 seconds, which deals 50% – 60% (based on level) AD physical damage, increased to 100% AD against minions. He will shoot the same target, else another target within 50 units beyond his basic attack range automatically.

description2.plain: The second shot applies life steal and on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, and is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description3.plain: Innate - Vigilance: Whenever Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is immobilized, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal 5 (+ 15% AD) bonus magic damage on-hit. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lucian}} fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.notes:
* ''Piercing Light'' will attempt to lead the target if it is moving but does not adjust further during the cast time (enemies can dodge the laser if they change their position by a sufficient amount during the cast time).
* '''Lucian''' can buffer {{ai|W|Lucian}} or {{ai|R|Lucian}} during the cast time. {{ai|E|Lucian}} is locked out.
** This is why '''Lucian''' can use them early if the cast time prematurely ends.
* ''Piercing Light's cast time ends prematurely if the initial target dies, allowing '''Lucian''' to attack and move freely, or to immediately begin casting either {{ai|W|Lucian}} or {{ai|R|Lucian}}.{{bug|2}}''

blurb.plain: Active: Lucian fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

description.plain: Active: Lucian fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy that deals physical damage to enemies hit.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lucian}} fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and marking enemies hit.
params.blurb3: '''Lucian''' briefly gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
params.description2: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.
params.description3: '''Lucian''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.
params.width: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|110|initial missile width}}<!-- / {{tt|X|length of star tips}} / {{tt|X|width of star tips}}-->
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** Like most [[projectile|missiles]], it will not collide with enemies whose center is beyond the maximum range (not behind '''Lucian'''), but this determines only the center and timing of the explosion.
* ''Ardent Blaze'' will cast from wherever '''Lucian''' is at the end of the cast time.
* '''Lucian''' will not gain ''Ardent Blaze's'' bonus movement speed if attacks on {{as|marked|buzzword}} targets are {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or if missed while the attacker is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* {{tip|persistent damage|DoTs}} will proc ''Ardent Blaze'' only once.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the mark.

blurb.plain: Active: Lucian fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or maximum range, dealing magic damage and marking enemies hit.

blurb3.plain: Lucian briefly gains bonus movement speed when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant Lucian Lightslinger.

description.plain: Active: Lucian fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and granting sight of the area for 1 second.

description2.plain: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.

description3.plain: Lucian gains bonus movement speed for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant Lucian Lightslinger.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Relentless Pursuit's'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} for each ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian}}'' shot hit, doubled against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Relentless Pursuit's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second for each ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian}}'' shot hit, doubled to 2 seconds against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description3: ''Relentless Pursuit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lucian's''' basic attack timer. '''Lucian''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash. Relentless Pursuit can be cast during {{ais|W|Lucian}} cast time and during {{ais|R|Lucian}} channel.''
params.notes:
* Additional on-hits during ''Lightslinger'' are not considered for the cooldown reduction (i.e {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}, {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}).
* Unlike some dashes, '''Lucian's''' dash speed does ''not'' scale with his {{as|movement speed}}.
* ''Relentless Pursuit's'' dash can go through terrain, but will not be extended further if the target location is within terrain, unlike other dashes, like {{ci|Ekko}}'s {{ai|Phase Dive|Ekko}}.
* Casting ''Relentless Pursuit'' directly after attacking with ''Lightslinger'' will reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown when the projectiles hit the target.
* ''Relentless Pursuit'' can be cast during {{sis|Recall}} cast time.
** If ''Relentless Pursuit'' is cast just as the cast time ends, '''Lucian''' will not perform his Recall animation, instead staying idle. This allows '''Lucian''' to use his [[Emoting|emotes]] during his Recall.

blurb.plain: Passive: Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is reduced for each Lightslinger shot hit, doubled against enemy champions.

blurb2.plain: Active: Lucian dashes in the target direction.

description.plain: Passive: Relentless Pursuit's current cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each Lightslinger shot hit, doubled to 2 seconds against enemy champions.

description2.plain: Active: Lucian dashes in the target direction.

description3.plain: Relentless Pursuit resets Lucian's basic attack timer. Lucian can cast any of his abilities during the dash. Relentless Pursuit can be cast during W cast time and during R channel.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lucian}} {{tip|channels}} for a few seconds to rapidly fire a torrent of bullets in the target direction. Each shot deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit. ''The Culling'' can be recast within the duration.
params.blurb2: While channeling, '''Lucian''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and may still move.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' {{tip|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, rapidly firing up to 22 {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 22.222|flat=true|round=floor|critScaling=true}})|crit chance}} shots in the target direction over the duration. Each shot deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}. ''The Culling'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.
